source.text: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις, προσευχάς, ἐντεύξεις, εὐχαριστίας, ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων, ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων, ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι.

records.literal_gloss: I urge therefore first of all to be made requests, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings for all men, \v 2 for kings and all those in high position being, so that a quiet and peaceful life we may lead in all godliness and dignity.

en.L: First of all, then, I urge that requests, prayers, intercessions [and] thanksgivings be made for {{gender:all people|all men}}, \v 2 for kings and all who are in high positions, so that we may lead a quiet and peaceful life in all godliness and dignity.
en.B: First of all, then, I urge that requests, prayers, intercessions and thanks be offered for {{gender:everyone|all men}}: \v 2 for kings and for all who hold high office, so that we may live peaceful and quiet lives, fully devoted to God and worthy of respect.
en.R: First, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help them, pray for them, speak to God for them, and thank God for them. \v 2 Pray for kings and for everyone who has power over others, so that we can live in peace and quiet, honoring God and living good lives.

fr.L: J’exhorte donc, avant tout, à faire des demandes, des prières, des intercessions, des actions de grâces pour {{gender:tous les humains|tous les hommes}}, \v 2 pour les rois et tous ceux qui sont en position d’autorité, afin que nous menions une vie calme et paisible en toute piété et dignité.
fr.B: Avant tout, donc, je demande qu’on présente à Dieu des demandes, des prières, des intercessions et des remerciements pour {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} : \v 2 pour les rois et pour tous ceux qui exercent l’autorité, afin que nous puissions mener une vie paisible et tranquille, entièrement attachés à Dieu et dignes de respect.
fr.R: Tout d’abord, il faut prier pour tout le monde. Il faut demander à Dieu de les aider, prier pour eux, parler à Dieu en leur faveur, et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} remercier pour eux. \v 2 Il faut prier pour les rois et pour tous ceux qui ont du pouvoir sur les autres, afin que nous puissions vivre dans la paix et le calme, en honorant Dieu et en menant une vie bonne.

es.L: Exhorto, pues, ante todo, a que se hagan peticiones, oraciones, intercesiones [y] acciones de gracias por {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}, \v 2 por los reyes y por todos los que están en altos puestos, para que llevemos una vida tranquila y sosegada con toda piedad y dignidad.
es.B: Ante todo, pues, pido que se hagan peticiones, oraciones, intercesiones y acciones de gracias por {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}: \v 2 por los reyes y por todos los que ocupan altos cargos, para que podamos vivir en paz y tranquilidad, con una vida de piedad y dignidad.
es.R: Primero, te pido que ores por todos. Pide a Dios que los ayude, ora por ellos, habla con Dios a favor de ellos y dale gracias por ellos. \v 2 Ora por los reyes y por todos los que tienen poder sobre otros, para que podamos vivir en paz y tranquilidad, honrando a Dios y llevando una vida buena.

sw.L: Basi, kwanza kabisa nasihi kwamba dua, maombi, maombezi [na] shukrani zifanywe kwa ajili ya watu wote, \v 2 kwa ajili ya wafalme na wote walio katika vyeo vya juu, ili tuishi maisha ya utulivu na ya amani katika uchaji wote wa Mungu na heshima.
sw.B: Basi, kwanza kabisa, nasihi kwamba dua, maombi, maombezi na shukrani zitolewe kwa ajili ya watu wote: \v 2 kwa ajili ya wafalme na wote wenye vyeo vya juu, ili tuishi maisha ya amani na utulivu, tukimcha Mungu kikamilifu na tukistahili heshima.
sw.R: Kwanza kabisa, nataka mwaombee watu wote. Mwombeni Mungu awasaidie, waombeeni, semeni na Mungu kwa ajili yao, na mshukuruni Mungu kwa ajili yao. \v 2 Waombeeni wafalme na wote walio na mamlaka juu ya wengine, ili tuweze kuishi kwa amani na utulivu, tukimheshimu Mungu na kuishi maisha mema.

ko.L: 그러므로 무엇보다 먼저 내가 권합니다. 모든 사람을 위하여 간구와 기도와 중보 기도와 감사를 드리십시오. \v 2 왕들과 높은 자리에 있는 모든 사람을 위하여 [드리십시오]. 그것은 우리가 모든 경건과 품위 가운데 조용하고 평온한 삶을 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 무엇보다도 먼저 내가 권합니다. 모든 사람을 위해 간구와 기도와 중보 기도와 감사를 드리십시오. \v 2 왕들과 높은 자리에 있는 모든 사람을 위해서도 그렇게 하십시오. 그래서 우리가 온전히 하나님을 공경하며 품위 있게, 조용하고 평화로운 삶을 살 수 있게 하십시오.
ko.R: 먼저 나는 당신이 모든 사람을 위해 기도하기를 부탁합니다. 그들을 도와 달라고 하나님께 구하고, 그들을 위해 기도하고, 그들을 위해 하나님께 말씀드리고, 그들 때문에 하나님께 감사하십시오. \v 2 왕들과 다른 사람들을 다스리는 권력을 가진 모든 사람을 위해 기도하십시오. 그래야 우리가 하나님을 공경하고 바르게 살면서, 평화롭고 조용하게 살 수 있습니다.

vi.L: Vậy, trước hết, ta khuyên rằng phải dâng lên những lời nài xin, cầu nguyện, cầu thay và tạ ơn cho mọi người, \v 2 cho các vua và tất cả những người ở địa vị cao, để chúng ta được sống một đời yên tĩnh và bình an trong mọi sự tin kính và đứng đắn.
vi.B: Vậy, trước hết, ta khuyên phải dâng lên những lời nài xin, cầu nguyện, cầu thay và cảm tạ cho mọi người: \v 2 cho các vua và cho tất cả những người giữ chức vụ cao, để chúng ta được sống đời bình an và yên tĩnh, hết lòng tin kính Đức Chúa Trời và đáng được tôn trọng.
vi.R: Trước hết, ta xin con hãy cầu nguyện cho mọi người. Hãy xin Đức Chúa Trời giúp đỡ họ, cầu nguyện cho họ, thưa với Đức Chúa Trời thay cho họ, và cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời vì họ. \v 2 Hãy cầu nguyện cho các vua và cho mọi người có quyền trên người khác, để chúng ta có thể sống bình an và yên tĩnh, tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời và sống đời tốt đẹp.

pt.L: Exorto, pois, antes de tudo, que se façam pedidos, orações, intercessões [e] ações de graças por {{gender:todos os seres humanos|todos os homens}}, \v 2 pelos reis e por todos os que estão em posição elevada, para que levemos uma vida tranquila e sossegada, em toda piedade e dignidade.
pt.B: Antes de tudo, então, peço que sejam feitos pedidos, orações, intercessões e agradecimentos por {{gender:todos|todos os homens}}: \v 2 pelos reis e por todos os que ocupam altos cargos, para que vivamos uma vida tranquila e em paz, inteiramente dedicada a Deus e digna de respeito.
pt.R: Em primeiro lugar, peço que a igreja ore por todas as pessoas: que peça a Deus que as ajude, ore por elas, fale com Deus em favor delas e agradeça a Deus por elas. \v 2 Que ore pelos reis e por todos os que têm poder sobre os outros, para que possamos viver em paz e tranquilidade, honrando a Deus e levando uma vida boa.

decisions.choice: requests, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings
decisions.reason: The four words overlap and together cover every kind of prayer. ἐντεύξεις is prayer on behalf of others.

decisions.choice: for all people
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπων is the general word for human beings. "All people" is a theme of the passage (verses 4, 6).

decisions.choice: kings and all in high positions: the emperor and the authorities
decisions.reason: In Paul's world "the king" was the Roman emperor (1 Peter 2:13-17). Jews prayed for the rulers of the nations they lived among (Jeremiah 29:7).

decisions.choice: godliness: devotion to God shown in life
decisions.reason: εὐσεβείᾳ is a key word of these letters (3:16; 4:7-8; 6:6): reverence for God that shapes how one lives.

decisions.choice: {{gender:all people|all men}} (L); {{gender:everyone|all men}} (B)
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general (m2); "men" is the traditional form.

decisions.choice: Ask God to help them, pray for them, speak to God for them, and thank God for them
decisions.reason: Readable turns the four nouns into actions (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:tous les humains|tous les hommes}} (L); {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} (B); "tout le monde" with no span (R)
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general (m2). Balanced does not follow the English "everyone" with "tout le monde", because in verse 4 the same phrase governs a verb, and "tout le monde soit sauvé" (singular) and "tous les hommes soient sauvés" (plural) would not agree; a plural noun keeps both options correct. Readable's "tout le monde" is already inclusive and needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "il faut prier" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek names no one: Paul urges that prayers be made, by the church that Timothy leads. French would have to choose between "tu" (Timothy alone) and "vous" (the church) for the English "you"; the impersonal form keeps the instruction open, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}
decisions.reason: As the English span: the Greek means all human beings (m2); the traditional "todos los hombres" is the alternative. Where an adjective must agree (2:4), the span says "todos los seres humanos" so both options stay masculine plural.

decisions.choice: piedad (L, B); honrando a Dios (R)
decisions.reason: As in Titus: "piedad" for this word throughout the Pastoral letters; Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: watu wote, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has {{gender:all people|all men}}. Swahili "watu" means people, men and women, and "wanaume" would mean males only and change the meaning (m2), so the setting has nothing to change; the same holds in verse 4.

decisions.choice: uchaji wa Mungu (L); tukimcha Mungu (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide term, as in Titus 1:1: "uchaji wa Mungu" is reverence for God that shows in how one lives (m4); "utauwa", the older church word, is little understood today. Balanced turns the noun into the verb "kumcha Mungu" where the sentence flows better.

decisions.choice: mwaombee, mwombeni (plural you)
decisions.reason: Paul writes to Timothy, but the prayers are those of the whole church. Swahili must choose singular or plural for the Readable command, and the plural shows that the church is meant.

decisions.choice: "모든 사람" with no gender span, here and in verse 4
decisions.reason: Where the English offers "all people" or "all men", Korean "모든 사람" already means people of either sex, so the gender setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "경건" (L); "하나님을 공경하며" (B, R), through the Pastoral letters
decisions.reason: Godliness is devotion to God shown in life (the meaning decision), a key word of these letters. "경건" is the established Korean word, kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable say what it is, "honoring God", so the word does not suggest outward piety only.

decisions.choice: "sự tin kính" (L), "tin kính Đức Chúa Trời" (B); "tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời" (R) for godliness (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The word is devotion to God shown in life (m4), one of the key words of these letters. "Tin kính" is the Protestant church word and the opposite of "không tin kính" in the Vietnamese Romans (1:18); "đạo đức" now means only good morals. Readable says what it is.

decisions.choice: "mọi người", with no gender span (also 2:4)
decisions.reason: "Mọi người" already includes everyone (m2), so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "cầu thay" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The church word for praying on another's behalf, as in the Vietnamese Romans (8:26).

decisions.choice: a piedade (L); devoção a Deus, dedicada a Deus (B); R as the English
decisions.reason: For the whole book, and offered to 2 Timothy and Titus: eusebeia, devotion to God shown in life (m4), is "piedade" at Literal, the traditional word. In everyday Brazilian Portuguese "piedade" first means pity, so Balanced says "devoção a Deus" (or "dedicada a Deus" where the English Balanced makes it an adjective), and Readable follows the English ("honrar a Deus", "viver de um modo que agrada a Deus").

decisions.choice: peço que a igreja ore
decisions.reason: The Greek has no "you": it asks that prayers be made, by the church at its meetings (verse 8). The English Readable says "you"; Portuguese would have to choose between Timothy alone ("você") and a plural the letter does not use here, so Readable names the church.

source.text: τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ, ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: This [is] good and acceptable before the Savior of us God, \v 4 who all men wants to be saved and to [the] knowledge of [the] truth to come.

en.L: This [is] good and pleasing before God our Savior, \v 4 who wants {{gender:all people|all men}} to be saved and to come to [the] knowledge of [the] truth.
en.B: This is good, and it pleases God our Savior, \v 4 who wants {{gender:everyone|all men}} to be saved and to come to know the truth.
en.R: This is good, and it pleases God our Savior. \v 4 God wants all people to be saved and to know the truth.

fr.L: Cela [est] bon et agréable devant Dieu notre Sauveur, \v 4 qui veut que {{gender:tous les humains|tous les hommes}} soient sauvés et parviennent à la connaissance de la vérité.
fr.B: Cela est bon, et c’est agréable à Dieu notre Sauveur, \v 4 qui veut que {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} soient sauvés et arrivent à connaître la vérité.
fr.R: C’est une bonne chose, et cela plaît à Dieu notre Sauveur. \v 4 Dieu veut que tous les gens soient sauvés et connaissent la vérité.

es.L: Esto [es] bueno y agradable delante de Dios nuestro Salvador, \v 4 que quiere que {{gender:todos los seres humanos|todos los hombres}} sean salvos y lleguen al conocimiento de [la] verdad.
es.B: Esto es bueno y agrada a Dios nuestro Salvador, \v 4 que quiere que {{gender:todos los seres humanos|todos los hombres}} sean salvos y lleguen a conocer la verdad.
es.R: Esto es bueno y agrada a Dios nuestro Salvador. \v 4 Dios quiere que todos se salven y conozcan la verdad.

sw.L: Hili [ni] jema na linakubalika mbele ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu, \v 4 ambaye anataka watu wote waokolewe na wafikie ujuzi wa kweli.
sw.B: Hili ni jema, nalo linampendeza Mungu Mwokozi wetu, \v 4 anayetaka watu wote waokolewe na waijue kweli.
sw.R: Hili ni jema, nalo linampendeza Mungu Mwokozi wetu. \v 4 Mungu anataka watu wote waokolewe na waijue kweli.

ko.L: 이것이 우리 구원자 하나님 앞에서 선하고 받으실 만한 일입니다. \v 4 그분은 모든 사람이 구원을 받고 진리를 아는 데에 이르기를 원하십니다.
ko.B: 이것은 선한 일이며, 우리 구원자 하나님께서 기뻐하시는 일입니다. \v 4 하나님께서는 모든 사람이 구원을 받고 진리를 알게 되기를 원하십니다.
ko.R: 이것은 좋은 일이며, 우리 구원자 하나님을 기쁘시게 합니다. \v 4 하나님께서는 모든 사람이 구원을 받고 진리를 알기를 원하십니다.

vi.L: Điều này là tốt và đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời, Cứu Chúa chúng ta, \v 4 là Đấng muốn mọi người được cứu và đến sự hiểu biết chân lý.
vi.B: Điều này là tốt và đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời, Cứu Chúa chúng ta, \v 4 là Đấng muốn mọi người được cứu và hiểu biết chân lý.
vi.R: Điều này là tốt, và làm đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời, Cứu Chúa chúng ta. \v 4 Đức Chúa Trời muốn mọi người được cứu và biết chân lý.

pt.L: Isto [é] bom e aceitável diante de Deus, nosso Salvador, \v 4 que quer que {{gender:todos os seres humanos|todos os homens}} sejam salvos e cheguem ao conhecimento da verdade.
pt.B: Isso é bom e agrada a Deus, nosso Salvador, \v 4 que quer que {{gender:todos|todos os homens}} sejam salvos e cheguem a conhecer a verdade.
pt.R: Isso é bom e agrada a Deus, nosso Salvador. \v 4 Deus quer que todas as pessoas sejam salvas e conheçam a verdade.

decisions.choice: God wants all people to be saved
decisions.reason: θέλω expresses God's desire. Because God wants all to be saved, prayer is for all (verse 1). Paul does not here discuss how God's desire relates to those who refuse it.

decisions.choice: the knowledge of the truth: coming to know the gospel
decisions.reason: ἐπίγνωσιν is real, personal knowledge (Colossians 1:9). "The truth" is the gospel (2 Timothy 2:25; Titus 1:1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:all people|all men}} (L); {{gender:everyone|all men}} (B)
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todos os seres humanos|todos os homens}}
decisions.reason: "Seres humanos" is masculine in grammar like "homens", so "salvos" agrees under either option; "pessoas" would need "salvas". The same in verse 1.

source.text: εἷς γὰρ θεός, εἷς καὶ μεσίτης θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς, ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων, τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις·

records.literal_gloss: One for God, one also mediator of God and men, a man Christ Jesus, \v 6 the [one] having given himself [as] a ransom for all, the testimony in its own times;

en.L: For [there is] one God, and one mediator between God and {{gender:humankind|men}}, the man {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, \v 6 who gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} [as] a ransom for all, the testimony [given] at the proper time.
en.B: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and humanity, {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} human, \v 6 who gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} as a ransom for all. This was the testimony given at the right time.
en.R: There is only one God. And there is only one who can bring God and people together. He is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, who became a human being. \v 6 He gave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} life to pay the price that would set all people free. God showed us this at the right time.

fr.L: Car [il y a] un seul Dieu, et un seul médiateur entre Dieu et {{gender:les humains|les hommes}}, un homme, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, \v 6 qui s’est donné {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} en rançon pour tous, le témoignage [rendu] au temps fixé.
fr.B: Car il y a un seul Dieu, et un seul médiateur entre Dieu et l’humanité, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, homme {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, \v 6 qui s’est donné {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} en rançon pour tous. C’est là le témoignage rendu au moment voulu.
fr.R: Il n’y a qu’un seul Dieu. Et il n’y a qu’un seul médiateur qui peut réunir Dieu et les humains : c’est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, qui est devenu un être humain. \v 6 Il a donné {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} vie pour payer le prix qui libère tous les humains. Dieu nous l’a montré au moment voulu.

es.L: Porque [hay] un solo Dios, y un solo mediador entre Dios y {{gender:la humanidad|los hombres}}, el hombre {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús, \v 6 que se dio a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} [como] rescate por todos, el testimonio [dado] a su debido tiempo.
es.B: Porque hay un solo Dios, y un solo mediador entre Dios y la humanidad, {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, que es también hombre, \v 6 que se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} como rescate por todos. Este fue el testimonio dado en el momento oportuno.
es.R: Hay un solo Dios. Y hay uno solo que puede unir a Dios y a la gente. Ese es {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, que se hizo ser humano. \v 6 Él dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} vida para pagar el precio que haría libres a todos. Dios nos mostró esto en el momento oportuno.

sw.L: Kwa maana [yuko] Mungu mmoja, na mpatanishi mmoja kati ya Mungu na wanadamu, mwanadamu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, \v 6 aliyejitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} [kuwa] fidia kwa ajili ya wote, ushuhuda [uliotolewa] kwa wakati wake.
sw.B: Kwa maana yuko Mungu mmoja, na mpatanishi mmoja kati ya Mungu na wanadamu, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, ambaye {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwenyewe ni mwanadamu, \v 6 aliyejitoa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kuwa fidia kwa ajili ya wote. Huo ndio ushuhuda uliotolewa kwa wakati uliofaa.
sw.R: Yuko Mungu mmoja tu. Na yuko mmoja tu anayeweza kuwapatanisha Mungu na watu. Yeye ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, aliyekuwa mwanadamu. \v 6 Alitoa uhai {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ili kulipa gharama ya kuwaweka huru watu wote. Mungu alituonyesha jambo hili kwa wakati uliofaa.

ko.L: 하나님은 한 분이시고, 하나님과 사람들 사이의 중개자도 한 분이시니, 곧 사람이신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수이십니다. \v 6 그분은 모든 사람을 위하여 자기 자신을 대속물로 내주셨으니, 이것은 정한 때에 [주신] 증거입니다.
ko.B: 하나님은 한 분이시고, 하나님과 인류 사이의 중개자도 한 분이십니다. 그분은 사람이신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수이십니다. \v 6 그분은 모든 사람을 위해 자기 자신을 대속물로 내주셨습니다. 이것은 알맞은 때에 주어진 증거입니다.
ko.R: 하나님은 오직 한 분이십니다. 그리고 하나님과 사람들을 하나로 이어 줄 수 있는 분도 오직 한 분이십니다. 그분은 사람이 되신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수이십니다. \v 6 그분은 모든 사람을 자유롭게 하는 값을 치르시려고 자기 목숨을 내주셨습니다. 하나님께서는 알맞은 때에 이것을 우리에게 보여 주셨습니다.

vi.L: Vì [chỉ có] một Đức Chúa Trời, và một Đấng trung gian giữa Đức Chúa Trời và loài người, là một con người, {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, \v 6 là Đấng đã phó chính mình [làm] giá chuộc cho mọi người, là lời chứng [được ban ra] vào đúng thời điểm.
vi.B: Vì chỉ có một Đức Chúa Trời, và chỉ có một Đấng trung gian giữa Đức Chúa Trời và loài người, là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là một con người, \v 6 là Đấng đã phó chính mình làm giá chuộc cho mọi người. Đó là lời chứng được ban ra vào đúng thời điểm.
vi.R: Chỉ có một Đức Chúa Trời. Và chỉ có một Đấng có thể đem Đức Chúa Trời và con người đến với nhau. Ngài là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, là Đấng đã trở nên một con người. \v 6 Ngài đã hy sinh mạng sống mình để trả giá giải thoát mọi người. Đức Chúa Trời đã cho chúng ta thấy điều này vào đúng thời điểm.

pt.L: Pois [há] um só Deus, e um só mediador entre Deus e {{gender:a humanidade|os homens}}, um homem, {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus, \v 6 que deu a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} [como] resgate por todos, o testemunho [dado] no tempo devido.
pt.B: Pois há um só Deus, e um só mediador entre Deus e a humanidade: {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mesmo humano, \v 6 que deu a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} como resgate por todos. Esse foi o testemunho dado no tempo certo.
pt.R: Existe um só Deus. E existe um só que pode aproximar Deus e as pessoas. É {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus, que se tornou um ser humano. \v 6 Ele deu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vida para pagar o preço que libertaria todas as pessoas. Deus nos mostrou isso no tempo certo.

decisions.choice: one God: the confession of Israel
decisions.reason: "The LORD our God, the LORD is one" (Deuteronomy 6:4). Because there is one God of all, there is one way to him for all (Romans 3:29-30).

decisions.choice: mediator: one who stands between two parties to bring them together
decisions.reason: μεσίτης is a go-between. Moses is called a mediator in Galatians 3:19-20; here Christ alone fills that role.

decisions.choice: a man, Christ Jesus: himself a human being
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπος is the general word for a human being. The point is that the mediator shares the humanity of those he brings to God.

decisions.choice: gave himself as a ransom for all: the saying of Jesus in Mark 10:45
decisions.reason: Jesus said he came "to give his life as a ransom for many" (Mark 10:45). ἀντίλυτρον is a strengthened form of the word for ransom, the price paid to set captives free. "For all" picks up verses 1 and 4.

decisions.choice: the testimony at the proper time: Christ's self-giving is God's witness, given when the time had come
decisions.reason: The phrase stands loosely in the sentence: the giving of Christ is the testimony God bore, at the time God chose (Galatians 4:4; Titus 1:3).

decisions.choice: humankind (L); humanity (B); people (R); the man (L); himself human (B); who became a human being (R)
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπων means human beings in general; Literal offers "men" as the traditional form. ἄνθρωπος stresses that Christ is human (m3).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: gave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} life to pay the price that would set all people free
alternatives: gave himself as a ransom for all
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ransom" (m4).

decisions.choice: {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} ... un homme (L)
decisions.reason: As in English, the first word means human beings in general and Literal offers "les hommes" as the traditional form; the second is said of Christ, who was a man, so "un homme" takes no setting. The traditional option keeps the echo of the Greek ("les hommes, un homme"); the default keeps the sense.

decisions.choice: que es también hombre
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "himself human". Spanish says it with a relative clause, which reads naturally and needs no pronoun; the point is the same, that the mediator is himself a human being (m3).

decisions.choice: rescate
decisions.reason: The word for the price paid to set a captive or slave free (m4); "rescate" means that price in Spanish. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: wanadamu ... mwanadamu, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu" (human beings) and "mwanadamu" (a human being) come from the same word, so Swahili keeps the link the Greek makes between humankind and the man Christ Jesus (m3) without a setting: both words already include men and women.

decisions.choice: fidia
decisions.reason: "Fidia" is the price paid to set someone free, which is the picture of the saying in Mark 10:45 (m4). Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "사람이신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수" (L, B); "사람이 되신" (R); "사람들", "인류" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Christ Jesus is himself a human being (the meaning decision). Korean "사람" says that without making it "a man" as against a woman, so where the English Literal offers "humankind" or "men" Korean needs no setting; the honorific "이신" keeps him Lord.

decisions.choice: "대속물" (L, B); "모든 사람을 자유롭게 하는 값을 치르시려고" (R)
decisions.reason: The ransom recalls Jesus' saying in Mark 10:45 (the meaning decision). "대속물" (a ransom paid in another's place) is the established word and is still understood; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. "중개자" is the word used for the mediator in Galatians 3:19-20.

decisions.choice: "Đấng trung gian" (L, B); "giá chuộc" (L, B), "trả giá giải thoát" (R)
decisions.reason: The mediator here is Christ, so "Đấng", against "người trung gian" for Moses in Galatians 3:19. The ransom is the saying of Jesus in Mark 10:45 (m4), "giá chuộc" in the Vietnamese Mark.

decisions.choice: "loài người", "một con người", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Loài người" and "con người" are human beings of either sex; "a man" here means a human being (m3), so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: um homem, {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus
decisions.reason: Portuguese cannot put "o homem" directly before "o Messias", so Literal sets the title off with a comma, which reads naturally under both options and keeps "homem" first, as the Greek does (m3). "Homem" means a human being here; Balanced and Readable say "humano", as the English does.

source.text: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ ψεύδομαι διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: for which was appointed I a herald and apostle, truth I speak, not I lie, a teacher of Gentiles in faith and truth.

en.L: For this I was appointed a herald and an apostle (I am telling the truth, I am not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
en.B: For this purpose I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth; I am not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
en.R: God chose me to tell this good news and to be an apostle. I am telling you the truth. I am not lying. God made me a teacher of people who are not Jews, to teach them about faith and the truth.

fr.L: Pour cela, moi, j’ai été établi héraut et apôtre (je dis la vérité, je ne mens pas), enseignant des nations dans la foi et la vérité.
fr.B: C’est pour cela que j’ai été établi prédicateur et apôtre (je dis la vérité, je ne mens pas), enseignant des non-Juifs dans la foi et la vérité.
fr.R: Dieu m’a choisi pour annoncer cette bonne nouvelle et pour être apôtre. Je te dis la vérité. Je ne mens pas. Dieu a fait de moi celui qui enseigne les gens qui ne sont pas juifs, pour leur faire connaître la foi et la vérité.

es.L: Para esto fui puesto yo como heraldo y apóstol (digo la verdad, no miento), maestro de los gentiles en fe y verdad.
es.B: Para esto fui nombrado predicador y apóstol (digo la verdad; no miento), maestro de los gentiles en la fe y la verdad.
es.R: Dios me escogió para anunciar esta buena noticia y para ser apóstol. Te digo la verdad. No miento. Dios me hizo maestro de los que no son judíos, para enseñarles acerca de la fe y la verdad.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya hilo niliwekwa mimi kuwa mpiga mbiu na mtume (nasema kweli, sisemi uongo), mwalimu wa watu wa mataifa katika imani na kweli.
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya kusudi hilo niliwekwa kuwa mhubiri na mtume (nasema kweli; sisemi uongo), mwalimu wa watu wa mataifa katika imani na kweli.
sw.R: Mungu alinichagua niitangaze habari njema hii na niwe mtume. Ninakuambia kweli. Sisemi uongo. Mungu alinifanya mwalimu wa watu wasio Wayahudi, niwafundishe kuhusu imani na kweli.

ko.L: 나는 이것을 위하여 선포자와 사도로 세움을 받았고 (내가 참말을 하지 거짓말을 하는 것이 아닙니다), 믿음과 진리 안에서 이방 사람들의 교사로 [세움을 받았습니다].
ko.B: 이 일을 위해 나는 복음을 전하는 사람과 사도로 세움을 받았습니다. (내가 참말을 하고 있으며, 거짓말을 하고 있지 않습니다.) 그리고 믿음과 진리 안에서 이방 사람들을 가르치는 교사로 세움을 받았습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 이 기쁜 소식을 전하고 사도가 되도록 나를 택하셨습니다. 나는 당신에게 참말을 하고 있습니다. 거짓말이 아닙니다. 하나님께서는 나를 유대인이 아닌 사람들을 가르치는 교사로 삼으셔서, 믿음과 진리에 대해 가르치게 하셨습니다.

vi.L: Vì điều đó, ta đã được lập làm người rao truyền và sứ đồ (ta nói thật, ta không nói dối), làm thầy dạy các dân ngoại trong đức tin và chân lý.
vi.B: Vì mục đích ấy, ta đã được lập làm người rao giảng và sứ đồ (ta nói thật, ta không nói dối), làm thầy dạy các dân ngoại trong đức tin và chân lý.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn ta để rao truyền Tin Lành này và làm sứ đồ. Ta nói thật với con. Ta không nói dối. Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho ta trở thành thầy dạy của những người không phải là người Do Thái, để dạy họ về đức tin và chân lý.

pt.L: Para isso eu fui designado arauto e apóstolo (digo a verdade, não minto), mestre das nações na fé e na verdade.
pt.B: Para isso fui designado pregador e apóstolo (digo a verdade, não estou mentindo), mestre dos não judeus na fé e na verdade.
pt.R: Deus me escolheu para anunciar essas boas-novas e para ser apóstolo. Estou dizendo a verdade a você. Não estou mentindo. Deus me fez mestre dos que não são judeus, para ensinar a eles a fé e a verdade.

decisions.choice: herald: one who announces a public message
decisions.reason: κῆρυξ was the public crier who announced a ruler's decrees.

decisions.choice: I am telling the truth, I am not lying: a solemn assurance
decisions.reason: The same oath-like words are in Romans 9:1. Paul's mission to the Gentiles was questioned by some.

decisions.choice: in faith and truth: faithfully and truly, or about faith and truth
decisions.reason: ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ may describe how he teaches or what he teaches; the sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: preacher
decisions.reason: "Herald" is now unfamiliar; the sense is one who proclaims (m1).

decisions.choice: people who are not Jews
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Gentiles".

decisions.choice: les nations (L); les non-Juifs (B); les gens qui ne sont pas juifs (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for the New Testament: "les Gentils" is no longer current French and "les païens" sounds pejorative today. Literal keeps the biblical "les nations"; Balanced and Readable say who is meant, as the English "Gentiles" and "people who are not Jews" do.

decisions.choice: heraldo (L); predicador (B)
decisions.reason: The word is a public herald (m1); Literal keeps "heraldo", Balanced says "predicador", as the English says "preacher".

decisions.choice: mpiga mbiu (L); mhubiri (B)
decisions.reason: The word is a herald who announces a public message (m1). "Mpiga mbiu" is the Swahili town crier who goes about announcing the chief's news, which keeps the picture at Literal; Balanced says "mhubiri" (preacher), as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "người rao truyền" (L); "người rao giảng" (B)
decisions.reason: A herald announces a public message (m1). "Rao truyền" keeps the sense of proclaiming aloud; "sứ giả" is kept for an envoy (Ephesians 6:20).

source.text: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: I want therefore to pray the men in every place, lifting up holy hands without anger and argument.

en.L: Therefore I want the men to pray in every place, lifting up holy hands without anger or argument.
en.B: So I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, free from anger and quarreling.
en.R: So I want the men in every place where you meet to pray. When they lift up their hands to God, their lives should be holy, and they should not be angry or arguing with each other.

fr.L: Je veux donc que les hommes prient en tout lieu, en élevant des mains saintes, sans colère ni dispute.
fr.B: Je veux donc que, partout, les hommes prient en levant des mains saintes, sans colère ni querelles.
fr.R: Je veux donc que, partout où vous vous réunissez, les hommes prient. Quand ils lèvent les mains vers Dieu, leur vie doit être sainte, et ils ne doivent pas être en colère ni se disputer entre eux.

es.L: Quiero, pues, que los hombres oren en todo lugar, levantando manos santas, sin ira ni discusión.
es.B: Así que quiero que en todas partes los hombres oren, levantando manos santas, libres de ira y de contiendas.
es.R: Así que quiero que los hombres oren en todos los lugares donde se reúnen los creyentes. Cuando levanten las manos a Dios, su vida debe ser santa, y no deben estar enojados ni discutiendo unos con otros.

sw.L: Basi nataka wanaume waombe kila mahali, wakiinua mikono mitakatifu bila hasira na mabishano.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nataka wanaume kila mahali waombe, wakiinua mikono mitakatifu, bila hasira wala ugomvi.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nataka wanaume waombe katika kila mahali mnapokutana. Wanapoinua mikono yao kwa Mungu, maisha yao yawe matakatifu, na wasiwe na hasira wala kubishana wao kwa wao.

ko.L: 그러므로 나는 남자들이 각처에서 분노와 다툼 없이 거룩한 손을 들고 기도하기를 원합니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 나는 어디서나 남자들이 화내거나 다투지 않고, 거룩한 손을 들고 기도하기를 바랍니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 여러분이 모이는 모든 곳에서 남자들이 기도하기를 바랍니다. 그들이 하나님께 손을 들 때, 그들의 삶은 거룩해야 하고, 서로 화내거나 다투지 말아야 합니다.

vi.L: Vậy ta muốn những người nam cầu nguyện ở mọi nơi, giơ tay thánh sạch lên, không giận dữ và không cãi cọ.
vi.B: Vậy ta muốn những người nam ở khắp nơi cầu nguyện, giơ tay thánh sạch lên, không giận dữ và không tranh cãi.
vi.R: Vậy ta muốn những người nam ở mọi nơi anh chị em nhóm họp đều cầu nguyện. Khi họ giơ tay lên với Đức Chúa Trời, đời sống họ phải thánh sạch, và họ không được giận dữ hay cãi cọ với nhau.

pt.L: Quero, pois, que os homens orem em todo lugar, levantando mãos santas, sem ira e sem discussão.
pt.B: Quero, então, que em todos os lugares os homens orem, levantando mãos santas, livres de raiva e de brigas.
pt.R: Por isso, quero que os homens orem em todos os lugares onde a igreja se reúne. Quando levantarem as mãos para Deus, a vida deles deve ser santa, e eles não devem estar com raiva nem discutindo uns com os outros.

decisions.choice: the men: the male members, as distinct from the women of verse 9
decisions.reason: ἄνδρας is the word for males (or husbands), not the general word for people used in verses 1-6. Paul addresses the men first, then the women.

decisions.choice: in every place: wherever the church gathers
decisions.reason: Probably every house where believers met in and around Ephesus (compare 1 Corinthians 1:2).

decisions.choice: lifting up holy hands: the ordinary posture of prayer
decisions.reason: Jews and Christians commonly prayed standing with hands raised (1 Kings 8:22; Psalm 141:2). "Holy" hands are hands not stained by wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: in every place where you meet; their lives should be holy
decisions.reason: Readable says what "every place" and "holy hands" mean (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: les hommes, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The word here means the male members of the church, set against the women of verse 9 (m1), so "les hommes" is meant as men and the inclusive setting does not apply.

decisions.choice: donde se reúnen los creyentes
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "where you meet". Paul writes to Timothy alone, and that "you" means the church; naming the believers avoids a plural you in a letter otherwise addressed with "tú".

decisions.choice: wanaume
decisions.reason: Here the Greek means the men as distinct from the women of verse 9 (m1), so Swahili says "wanaume" (males), with no setting.

decisions.choice: "남자들" at every level, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The word here means the male members, as distinct from the women of verse 9 (the meaning decision), so Korean says "남자들", as the English says "the men", and there is no setting to apply.

decisions.choice: "những người nam" at every level, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The men here are the male members, as distinct from the women of verse 9 (m1), so Vietnamese says "người nam", as the English says "men" with no span.

decisions.choice: os homens, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Here the Greek word means the male members, as against the women of verse 9 (m1), so "os homens" means men and takes no setting, as in the English. Readable says "onde a igreja se reúne" for the English "where you meet", which has no Greek "you" behind it.

source.text: ὡσαύτως καὶ γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς, μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν καὶ χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ, ἀλλ’ ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν, δι’ ἔργων ἀγαθῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Likewise also women in clothing respectable with modesty and self-control to adorn themselves, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or clothing expensive, \v 10 but what is fitting for women professing godliness, through works good.

en.L: Likewise also [I want] women to adorn themselves in respectable clothing, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or expensive clothing, \v 10 but with what is fitting for women who profess godliness: with good works.
en.B: In the same way, I want women to dress in a fitting way, with modesty and good sense, and not to make braided hair, gold, pearls or costly clothes their adornment, \v 10 but good works, as is right for women who claim to honor God.
en.R: In the same way, women should wear clothes that are modest and sensible. They should not try to make themselves look beautiful with fancy hairstyles, gold jewelry, pearls or expensive clothes. \v 10 Women who say they love God should make themselves beautiful by doing good things.

fr.L: De même aussi, [je veux] que les femmes se parent d’une tenue convenable, avec pudeur et modération, non de cheveux tressés et d’or ou de perles ou de vêtements coûteux, \v 10 mais de ce qui convient à des femmes qui font profession de piété : d’œuvres bonnes.
fr.B: De même, je veux que les femmes s’habillent de manière convenable, avec pudeur et bon sens, et qu’elles ne fassent pas des cheveux tressés, de l’or, des perles ou des vêtements de prix leur parure, \v 10 mais des œuvres bonnes, comme il convient à des femmes qui déclarent honorer Dieu.
fr.R: De même, les femmes doivent porter des vêtements simples et convenables. Elles ne doivent pas chercher à se rendre belles avec des coiffures compliquées, des bijoux en or, des perles ou des vêtements chers. \v 10 Les femmes qui disent aimer Dieu doivent se rendre belles en faisant du bien.

es.L: Asimismo también [quiero que] las mujeres se adornen con ropa decorosa, con pudor y sensatez, no con trenzas y oro, o perlas, o vestidos costosos, \v 10 sino con lo que es propio de mujeres que profesan reverencia a Dios: con obras buenas.
es.B: Del mismo modo, quiero que las mujeres se vistan de manera apropiada, con modestia y sensatez, y que su adorno no sean los peinados con trenzas, el oro, las perlas ni los vestidos costosos, \v 10 sino las obras buenas, como corresponde a mujeres que dicen honrar a Dios.
es.R: De la misma manera, las mujeres deben llevar ropa modesta y sensata. No deben tratar de verse hermosas con peinados llamativos, joyas de oro, perlas ni ropa cara. \v 10 Las mujeres que dicen que aman a Dios deben hacerse hermosas haciendo cosas buenas.

sw.L: Vivyo hivyo pia [nataka] wanawake wajipambe kwa mavazi yanayofaa, pamoja na adabu na kiasi, si kwa nywele zilizosukwa na dhahabu au lulu au mavazi ya gharama kubwa, \v 10 bali kwa yale yanayowafaa wanawake wanaodai kumcha Mungu: kwa kazi njema.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, nataka wanawake wavae kwa namna inayofaa, kwa adabu na kiasi, wala wasifanye nywele zilizosukwa, dhahabu, lulu au mavazi ya bei ghali kuwa ndiyo mapambo yao, \v 10 bali matendo mema, kama inavyowafaa wanawake wanaodai kumheshimu Mungu.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, wanawake wavae nguo za heshima na za busara. Wasijaribu kujipamba kwa mitindo ya nywele ya gharama, vito vya dhahabu, lulu au nguo za bei ghali. \v 10 Wanawake wanaosema kwamba wanampenda Mungu wajipambe kwa kutenda mambo mema.

ko.L: 이와 같이 여자들도 단정한 옷차림으로, 정숙함과 절제로 자기를 단장하고, 땋은 머리나 금이나 진주나 값비싼 옷으로 하지 말고, \v 10 경건을 고백하는 여자들에게 어울리는 것, 곧 선한 행실로 [단장하기를 원합니다].
ko.B: 이와 같이 나는 여자들도 단정하게 옷을 입고, 정숙하고 분별 있게 행동하기를 바랍니다. 땋은 머리나 금이나 진주나 값비싼 옷으로 꾸미지 말고, \v 10 하나님을 공경한다고 고백하는 여자들에게 어울리는 대로, 선한 일로 자기를 꾸미십시오.
ko.R: 마찬가지로 여자들도 단정하고 분별 있게 옷을 입어야 합니다. 화려한 머리 모양이나 금 장신구나 진주나 비싼 옷으로 아름답게 보이려고 하지 말아야 합니다. \v 10 하나님을 사랑한다고 말하는 여자들은 선한 일을 함으로써 자기를 아름답게 꾸며야 합니다.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, [ta muốn] người nữ trang điểm mình bằng y phục đứng đắn, với sự nết na và tự chủ, không phải bằng tóc bện, vàng, ngọc trai hay áo quần đắt tiền, \v 10 nhưng bằng điều xứng hợp với người nữ tuyên xưng lòng tin kính, tức là bằng những việc lành.
vi.B: Cũng vậy, ta muốn người nữ ăn mặc đứng đắn, nết na và biết suy xét, không lấy tóc bện, vàng, ngọc trai hay áo quần đắt tiền làm đồ trang sức, \v 10 nhưng lấy việc lành làm đồ trang sức, như điều xứng hợp với những người nữ xưng mình là người tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, người nữ nên mặc quần áo đứng đắn và hợp lẽ. Họ đừng tìm cách làm cho mình đẹp bằng những kiểu tóc cầu kỳ, nữ trang bằng vàng, ngọc trai hay quần áo đắt tiền. \v 10 Những người nữ nói rằng mình yêu mến Đức Chúa Trời nên làm cho mình đẹp bằng cách làm những việc tốt lành.

pt.L: Igualmente também [quero] que as mulheres se adornem com roupa decente, com pudor e sensatez, não com tranças e ouro ou pérolas ou vestes caras, \v 10 mas com o que convém a mulheres que professam reverência a Deus: com boas obras.
pt.B: Da mesma forma, quero que as mulheres se vistam de modo adequado, com modéstia e bom senso, e que não façam de tranças, ouro, pérolas ou roupas caras o seu enfeite, \v 10 mas sim de boas obras, como convém a mulheres que dizem honrar a Deus.
pt.R: Do mesmo modo, as mulheres devem usar roupas discretas e sensatas. Não devem tentar ficar bonitas com penteados enfeitados, joias de ouro, pérolas ou roupas caras. \v 10 As mulheres que dizem que amam a Deus devem se enfeitar com o bem que fazem.

decisions.choice: likewise: the same wish, perhaps also that the women pray
decisions.reason: ὡσαύτως ("likewise") carries over "I want" from verse 8, and may carry over "to pray" as well: women praying in a fitting manner (1 Corinthians 11:5).

decisions.choice: braided hair, gold, pearls, costly clothing: displays of wealth and status
decisions.reason: Elaborate hairstyles woven with gold and pearls were a mark of wealthy women in Roman cities, and moral writers of the time criticized them. 1 Peter 3:3-4 says the same.

decisions.choice: self-control: good sense, sound judgment
decisions.reason: σωφροσύνης is soundness of mind and self-restraint, a virtue for men and women alike in these letters (2:15; Titus 2:2-6).

decisions.choice: [I want]
decisions.reason: The verb carries over from verse 8 (m1).

decisions.choice: should make themselves beautiful by doing good things
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of adornment.

decisions.choice: sensatez
decisions.reason: The same word family as "sensato" in Titus and 3:2 here (m3), kept as one Spanish word so the repetition in 2:15 shows.

decisions.choice: kiasi (L, B); busara (R)
decisions.reason: As in Titus 2:2, this word family is "kiasi" (moderation, restraint) at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "busara" (good sense), as the English Readable says "sensible".

decisions.choice: "người nữ" for the women at every level in 2:9-15
decisions.reason: "Người nữ" is the word Paul's argument needs, set against "người nam" in verse 8 and taking up Genesis in verses 13-14; it is respectful and neutral as to age.

decisions.choice: sensatez (L); bom senso (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 2:15; 3:2). The word is soundness of mind and self-restraint (m3), a virtue of men and women alike; "sensatez" and "bom senso" say good judgment in everyday Portuguese, where "domínio próprio" is narrower and sounds like church language.

source.text: γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ·

records.literal_gloss: A woman in quietness let learn in all submission;

en.L: Let a woman learn in quietness, in all submission.
en.B: A woman should learn quietly and with full submission.
en.R: Women should learn quietly, and they should accept what they are taught.

fr.L: Que la femme apprenne dans le calme, en toute soumission.
fr.B: La femme doit apprendre dans le calme et avec une entière soumission.
fr.R: Les femmes doivent apprendre dans le calme, et accepter ce qu’on leur enseigne.

es.L: Que la mujer aprenda en quietud, con toda sumisión.
es.B: La mujer debe aprender con tranquilidad y con plena sumisión.
es.R: Las mujeres deben aprender con tranquilidad, y deben aceptar lo que se les enseña.

sw.L: Mwanamke na ajifunze kwa utulivu, kwa unyenyekevu wote.
sw.B: Mwanamke ajifunze kwa utulivu na kwa unyenyekevu kamili.
sw.R: Wanawake wajifunze kwa utulivu, na wayakubali yale wanayofundishwa.

ko.L: 여자는 조용히 모든 복종 가운데 배우십시오.
ko.B: 여자는 조용히, 온전히 순복하는 마음으로 배워야 합니다.
ko.R: 여자들은 조용히 배우고, 가르침을 받는 것을 받아들여야 합니다.

vi.L: Người nữ hãy học trong sự yên lặng, với mọi sự thuận phục.
vi.B: Người nữ nên học cách yên lặng và hoàn toàn thuận phục.
vi.R: Người nữ nên học cách yên lặng, và chấp nhận những gì mình được dạy.

pt.L: Que a mulher aprenda em quietude, com toda a submissão.
pt.B: A mulher deve aprender com tranquilidade e com plena submissão.
pt.R: As mulheres devem aprender com calma e devem aceitar o que é ensinado a elas.

decisions.choice: let a woman learn: a command that women be taught
decisions.reason: μανθανέτω is a command: women are to learn. In many settings of the time, women were not taught religious teaching.

decisions.choice: quietness: a calm, settled manner, not necessarily total silence
decisions.reason: ἡσυχίᾳ is the word used in verse 2 for a "quiet" life and in 2 Thessalonians 3:12; it describes a peaceable, undisturbed manner. Whether it means silence in the assembly or a quiet, receptive spirit is debated.

decisions.choice: in all submission: in full submission
decisions.reason: ὑποταγῇ is submission or subordination. The verse does not say to whom: to the teaching, to those who teach, or to husbands; readers differ.

decisions.choice: a woman: women in general, or wives
decisions.reason: γυνὴ can mean "woman" or "wife", and the word for man in verse 12 can mean "man" or "husband". The passage moves from women at prayer (verses 9-10) to Adam and Eve (verses 13-14), so it may concern women in the church or wives with their husbands.

decisions.choice: accept what they are taught
decisions.reason: Readable states one of the senses in m3, which the Greek leaves open.

decisions.choice: dans le calme (here and in verse 12)
decisions.reason: The word describes a calm, settled manner and need not mean total silence (m2), as the English "quietness" leaves open. "En silence" would decide the question; "dans le calme" keeps the wider sense.

decisions.choice: en quietud (L); con tranquilidad (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means a calm, settled manner, not necessarily complete silence (m2); "en silencio" would say more than the Greek. The same words in 2:12.

decisions.choice: mwanamke
decisions.reason: Like the Greek, "mwanamke" means both a woman and a wife, so Literal and Balanced leave open the question the meaning decision raises (m4); "mke" would decide it for wives.

decisions.choice: "조용히" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a calm, settled manner, not necessarily total silence, and marks it uncertain. "조용히" (quietly, calmly) keeps that; "잠잠히" is closer to "in silence". The same word returns in verse 12.

decisions.choice: "복종" (L); "순복하는 마음" (B); "가르침을 받는 것을 받아들여야" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun is from the verb rendered "복종하다" in Ephesians 5:21-24. Balanced uses "순복" (willing submission) so the phrase does not sound harsher than the Greek; Readable says what it means for a learner, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "yên lặng" at every level (also 2:12)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a calm, settled manner, not necessarily total silence (m2). "Yên lặng" is quiet and calm; "im lặng" would say only that no word is spoken.

decisions.choice: "thuận phục" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The word of the Vietnamese Colossians (3:18) and Ephesians (5:21-24) for this Greek noun, placing oneself under another willingly.

decisions.choice: em quietude (L); com tranquilidade (B); com calma (R)
decisions.reason: The word describes a calm, peaceable manner and is the word for the "quiet" life of verse 2; whether it means silence is debated (m2). "Em silêncio" would decide the question, so the levels say "quietude", "tranquilidade" and "calma", as the English says "quietness". The same in verse 12.

source.text: διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω, οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός, ἀλλ’ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: To teach but a woman not I permit, nor to have authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

en.L: But I do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man; rather, she is to be in quietness.
en.B: I do not allow a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
en.R: I do not allow a woman to teach a man or to have authority over him. She should be quiet.

fr.L: Mais je ne permets pas à une femme d’enseigner, ni d’avoir autorité sur un homme ; elle doit plutôt être dans le calme.
fr.B: Je ne permets pas à une femme d’enseigner ni d’exercer l’autorité sur un homme ; elle doit se tenir dans le calme.
fr.R: Je ne permets pas à une femme d’enseigner un homme ni d’avoir autorité sur lui. Elle doit rester dans le calme.

es.L: Pero no permito a la mujer enseñar ni ejercer autoridad sobre un hombre, sino estar en quietud.
es.B: No permito que la mujer enseñe ni que ejerza autoridad sobre un hombre; debe permanecer en quietud.
es.R: No permito que una mujer enseñe a un hombre ni que tenga autoridad sobre él. Debe estar tranquila.

sw.L: Lakini simruhusu mwanamke kufundisha wala kuwa na mamlaka juu ya mwanamume; bali awe katika utulivu.
sw.B: Simruhusu mwanamke kufundisha wala kutumia mamlaka juu ya mwanamume; abaki mtulivu.
sw.R: Simruhusu mwanamke kumfundisha mwanamume au kuwa na mamlaka juu yake. Anapaswa kuwa mtulivu.

ko.L: 나는 여자가 가르치거나 남자를 주관하는 것을 허락하지 않습니다. 오히려 조용히 있어야 합니다.
ko.B: 나는 여자가 가르치거나 남자에게 권위를 행사하는 것을 허락하지 않습니다. 여자는 조용히 있어야 합니다.
ko.R: 나는 여자가 남자를 가르치거나 남자에게 권위를 가지는 것을 허락하지 않습니다. 여자는 조용히 있어야 합니다.

vi.L: Nhưng ta không cho phép người nữ dạy dỗ hay cầm quyền trên người nam, nhưng phải ở trong sự yên lặng.
vi.B: Ta không cho phép người nữ dạy dỗ hay sử dụng quyền trên người nam; người nữ phải giữ yên lặng.
vi.R: Ta không cho phép người nữ dạy người nam hay có quyền trên người nam. Người nữ nên giữ yên lặng.

pt.L: Mas não permito que a mulher ensine nem que tenha autoridade sobre o homem; antes, que esteja em quietude.
pt.B: Não permito que a mulher ensine nem que exerça autoridade sobre o homem; ela deve permanecer em quietude.
pt.R: Não permito que uma mulher ensine um homem ou tenha autoridade sobre ele. Ela deve ficar calma e tranquila.

decisions.choice: to have authority over: to exercise authority
alternatives: to assume authority on one's own initiative
decisions.reason: αὐθεντέω occurs only here in the New Testament and is rare elsewhere. In the writings that use it, it means to have or exercise authority, and sometimes to act in a high-handed or domineering way. Which sense it has here is one of the most debated questions in the letter.

decisions.choice: to teach or to have authority over a man: two things, or one
alternatives: one thing: to teach in a domineering way over a man
decisions.reason: οὐδὲ ("nor") may join two separate activities, teaching and exercising authority, or two that belong together; and "over a man" may go with both verbs or only with the second.

decisions.choice: I do not permit: Paul's present instruction
decisions.reason: ἐπιτρέπω is present tense, "I do not permit". The verse gives a reason in verses 13-14 drawn from creation and the fall. Whether it states a rule for all churches at all times or answers the situation in Ephesus, where false teachers were at work (1:3-7) and some women were drawn in (5:13-15; 2 Timothy 3:6-7), is a question of interpretation; the text itself does not settle it.

decisions.choice: to be in quietness
decisions.reason: The same word as in verse 11 (see the note there).

decisions.choice: to have authority over (L, R); to exercise authority over (B)
decisions.reason: The renderings follow the most common sense of the verb (m1), which is uncertain; the footnote gives the others.

decisions.choice: to teach a man
decisions.reason: Readable follows the reading in which "a man" goes with both verbs (m2), which is uncertain.

decisions.choice: "주관하다" (L); "권위를 행사하다" (B); "권위를 가지다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the rare verb as exercising authority, with "domineer" or "take authority to oneself" as other readings, and marks it uncertain. Korean "주관하다" (to have charge over) and "권위를 행사하다" (to exercise authority) stay close to the reading chosen without adding the harsher sense.

decisions.choice: "cầm quyền trên" (L); "sử dụng quyền trên" (B); "có quyền trên" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the rare verb as to exercise authority, with the sense of seizing authority noted as another reading (m1). Vietnamese uses the neutral words for having and using authority and does not choose the other sense.

source.text: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη, εἶτα Εὕα·

records.literal_gloss: Adam for first was formed, then Eve;

en.L: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
en.B: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
en.R: God made Adam first, and then Eve.

fr.L: Car Adam a été formé le premier, puis Ève.
fr.B: Car Adam a été formé le premier, et Ève ensuite.
fr.R: Dieu a fait Adam en premier, et ensuite Ève.

es.L: Porque Adán fue formado primero, después Eva.
es.B: Porque Adán fue formado primero, y después Eva.
es.R: Dios hizo primero a Adán, y después a Eva.

sw.L: Kwa maana Adamu aliumbwa kwanza, kisha Hawa.
sw.B: Kwa maana Adamu aliumbwa kwanza, na baadaye Hawa.
sw.R: Mungu alimuumba Adamu kwanza, kisha akamuumba Hawa.

ko.L: 아담이 먼저 지음을 받았고, 그다음에 하와가 [지음을 받았기] 때문입니다.
ko.B: 아담이 먼저 지음을 받았고, 그다음에 하와가 지음을 받았기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 아담을 먼저 만드시고, 그다음에 하와를 만드셨기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Vì A-đam được dựng nên trước, rồi mới đến Ê-va.
vi.B: Vì A-đam được dựng nên trước, rồi mới đến Ê-va.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời dựng nên A-đam trước, rồi mới đến Ê-va.

pt.L: Pois Adão foi formado primeiro, depois Eva.
pt.B: Pois Adão foi formado primeiro, e depois Eva.
pt.R: Deus fez Adão primeiro, e depois Eva.

decisions.choice: Adam formed first, then Eve: Genesis 2:7 and 2:21-22
decisions.reason: πλάσσω is the verb the Greek Old Testament uses in Genesis 2:7 for God forming the man. Paul gives the order of creation as a reason for what he has just said.

decisions.choice: God made
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the maker (Genesis 2).

decisions.choice: "아담", "하와"
decisions.reason: The established Protestant Korean forms of the names.

source.text: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν.

records.literal_gloss: and Adam not was deceived, the but woman having been deceived into transgression has come.

en.L: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and came into transgression.
en.B: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and fell into sin.
en.R: And Adam was not the one who was tricked. The woman was tricked, and she disobeyed God.

fr.L: Et Adam n’a pas été trompé, mais la femme, ayant été trompée, est tombée dans la transgression.
fr.B: Et ce n’est pas Adam qui a été trompé ; c’est la femme qui a été trompée et qui est tombée dans le péché.
fr.R: Et ce n’est pas Adam qui a été trompé. C’est la femme qui a été trompée, et elle a désobéi à Dieu.

es.L: Y Adán no fue engañado, sino que la mujer, al ser engañada, incurrió en transgresión.
es.B: Y no fue Adán el engañado; fue la mujer la que fue engañada y cayó en pecado.
es.R: Y no fue Adán el que fue engañado. La mujer fue engañada, y desobedeció a Dios.

sw.L: Na Adamu hakudanganywa, bali mwanamke, akiwa amedanganywa, aliingia katika kosa.
sw.B: Tena Adamu hakuwa ndiye aliyedanganywa; mwanamke ndiye aliyedanganywa, akaanguka katika dhambi.
sw.R: Na Adamu hakuwa ndiye aliyedanganywa. Mwanamke ndiye aliyedanganywa, naye akamwasi Mungu.

ko.L: 그리고 아담은 속지 않았고, 여자가 속아서 범죄에 빠졌습니다.
ko.B: 그리고 속은 것은 아담이 아니었습니다. 여자가 속아서 죄에 빠졌습니다.
ko.R: 그리고 속은 사람은 아담이 아니었습니다. 여자가 속았고, 그래서 하나님께 불순종했습니다.

decisions.choice: saved through childbearing
alternatives: kept safe through the dangers of childbirth
saved through "the childbearing": the birth of the promised child, Christ (Genesis 3:15)
saved while living out her calling as wife and mother
decisions.reason: σῴζω elsewhere in these letters means salvation in Christ (2:4), and the condition that follows ("if they continue in faith") points the same way. τεκνογονίας is childbearing; with the article it may mean childbirth in general or a particular birth. Readers take the verse as saying that women are saved, not by teaching or authority, in the ordinary life of a woman of that time, or kept safe in childbirth, or saved through the birth of the Messiah promised in Genesis 3:15. The verse is among the most disputed in the letter.

decisions.choice: she ... they: the woman (Eve and women after her), then women in general
alternatives: they: the woman and her husband
decisions.reason: σωθήσεται ("she will be saved") is singular, picking up "the woman" of verse 14; μείνωσιν ("they continue") is plural, most likely women in general.

decisions.choice: self-control: good sense

decisions.choice: women

decisions.choice: si elles demeurent (L); si elles persévèrent (B)
decisions.reason: The English "they" has no gender, but French must give one. Following m2, "they" are women in general, after "she" (Eve and the women after her), so French writes the feminine "elles". "Ils" would suggest the husbands or the children, a reading the meaning decision does not take.

decisions.choice: dar a luz hijos (L, B); tener hijos (R)
decisions.reason: The noun names bearing children. "Maternidad" would widen it to motherhood, and "el parto" would narrow it to one birth, each settling a question m1 leaves open; a verbal phrase keeps the Greek's scope.

decisions.choice: ataokolewa ... watadumu
decisions.reason: The Greek moves from "she" to "they" (m2), and the Swahili subject prefixes show the same shift (a- singular, wa- plural) without adding a noun, so Literal and Balanced leave it as open as the Greek; Readable names "wanawake", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "그 여자는 ... 그들이" (L); "여자는 ... 여자들이" (B); "여자들이" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek moves from "she" (Eve and the women after her) to "they" (women in general), as the meaning decision says. Literal keeps the shift; Balanced names both with "여자"; Readable says "women", as the English Readable does. The meaning of "saved through childbearing" stays open, as the meaning decision marks it uncertain.

decisions.choice: Literal puts the condition ("if they continue ...") before the main clause
alternatives: the Greek order, with the condition last
decisions.reason: Korean puts a condition before what depends on it; the record has one verse, so nothing crosses a verse marker.

decisions.choice: "được cứu qua việc sinh con" at every level
alternatives: "được giữ an toàn khi sinh con"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves the sense open, with the main readings noted (m1). Vietnamese keeps the plain words of the Greek and does not choose; "người nữ" stands for "she", which can be heard as Eve and the women after her (m2).

decisions.choice: a geração de filhos (L); a maternidade (B)
decisions.reason: Portuguese has no single everyday noun for "childbearing". Literal says "geração de filhos", the bearing of children; Balanced says "maternidade", which covers bearing children and is plain. "O parto" would decide for one particular birth, a reading m1 mentions but leaves open.
